def settings(keys: list[str], values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Overlay keys[i] = values[i] on the defaults mode=fast and level=3.
    Returns the values in the order mode, level, then any other keys by first
    appearance in keys. A repeated key keeps its last value."""
    pre keys.len() == values.len()
    post out.len() >= 2
    ex settings(keys=[], values=[]) == ["fast", "3"]
    ex settings(keys=["level"], values=["5"]) == ["fast", "5"]
    ex settings(keys=["x", "mode", "x"], values=["1", "slow", "2"]) == ["slow", "3", "2"]
    vals: dict[str, str] = {"mode": "fast", "level": "3"}
    order: list[str] = ["mode", "level"]
    for i in range(keys.len()):
        k = keys[i]
        if k not in vals:
            order.append(k.copy())
        vals[k.copy()] = values[i].copy()
    res: list[str] = []
    for k in order:
        res.append((vals.get(k) else "").copy())
    return res
